description: You are a financial compliance analyst at a mid-size asset management firm. Your portfolio manager needs a structured summary of how the five largest U.S. banks by total assets (JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs) disclosed cybersecurity risks and incidents in their most recent annual 10-K filings on SEC EDGAR. Save the summary as JSON to ~/Documents/edgar_cybersecurity_audit.json. The file must contain one object per bank with fields: cik, company_name, fiscal_year_end, filing_date, and cybersecurity_risk_factor_excerpt (a verbatim excerpt of at least 100 words from the Item 1A risk factor section specifically discussing cybersecurity or technology risk).
